# hpe_morpheus_account (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Account (Tenant) resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the account.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the account is active.
- `currency` (String) The currency code (ISO 4217) for the account.
- `description` (String) The description of the account.
- `role_id` (Number) The default base role ID for the account.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain for the account. This will be part of the login URL and username for sub tenant users.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the account.
